assistant.pageSubtitle: Ask about pets, appointments, vaccinations, and deworming.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

assistant.greeting: Hi! I can help you with your pets, appointments, vaccinations, deworming records, and recommendations based on your account data.
assistant.help: I can tell you what pets you have, what appointments are coming up, what vaccinations or dewormings are due, and I can give simple recommendations based on your existing data.
assistant.unknown: I did not fully understand the request. Try something like: “What pets do I have?”, “What’s next for Rex?” or “Which vaccinations are due?”
assistant.noPets: I could not find any pets in your account.
assistant.noAppointments: You have no appointments in the next {{days}} days.

assistant.noVaccinations: I could not find any vaccinations for {{petName}}.
assistant.noDewormings: I could not find any deworming records for {{petName}}.
